messages:
alex: ci smoke perf alert from ci-bot - p50 increased ~18% on matmul-heavy workloads after infra AMI roll (CUDA 12.4, driver 535.41, LTO build) :warning: https://ci/internal/xyz

ci-bot: perf/smoke: p50=120ms -> 142ms, p95=310ms -> 380ms, test=small-batch-1 seq=256 model=redwood-small

maria: @alex saw this in staging too. suspected kernel selector swapped to a different cuBLAS algo on A100s with the new driver/LTO. :eyes:

suresh: I ran a quick flamegraph. matmul kernels show a 2.2x increase. KV cache memcpy looks unchanged.

suresh: profiling snippet:
```
# quick pyprof summary (combined sample)
matmul: 64.8% (was 29.1% pre-rollout)
kv_cache_lookup: 4.2%
memcpy_htod: 6.2%
other: 24.8%
```

jen: noticed batching tail latency increase too. heuristics might be picking larger batch sizes due to different warmup behavior, but per-op kernel is slower so latency suffers.

maria: linking suspect changes: infra/ami: bump-cuda12.4-driver-535.41 rolled 02:00 UTC; runtime: autotune-kernel-selector 9c7b2fd added LTO hints earlier this week. could be either.

alex: can someone bisect: driver delta vs selector commit? need to know whether to pin driver or revert selector. run smoke with old driver on a small fleet.

suresh: started bisect job: infra-smoke-old-driver-535.29 (job 4872) on s-6. ETA ~40m.

ci-bot: job 4872 started by suresh - https://ci/internal/job/4872

maria: if it's driver-only, pin driver on Dedicated and delay AMI rollout. if selector is culprit, revert 9c7b2fd and re-run canary.

jen: filing rollout-blocker and tagging infra + eng-runtime. @suresh please attach perf logs to the ticket. :clipboard:

alex: plan: (1) finish bisect; (2) if driver culprit, pin and rollback AMI; (3) if selector culprit, revert and hotfix. target: rollback/hotfix within 2h.

suresh: bisect result: running smoke on old-driver restores p50 to ~122ms. swapped selector back and still see the slowdown with new driver. driver looks like primary culprit. attaching before/after traces.

maria: thanks — opening infra/rollback PR and notifying cloud infra to hold the CUDA 12.4/535 rollout. we'll run a focused kernel micro-benchmark matrix (A100 LTO) before re-rolling. :thumbsup:

alex: good catch everyone. follow-up in #eng-runtime once infra rollback merges. closing thread after PR merges.
